harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured `/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker` as the enabled, reboot-persistent `inventory-worker` systemd service on node1. It runs under the dedicated locked `inventorysvc` account. RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0, SELinux enforcement, worker contents, SSH configuration, and administrative access were preserved.
actions_performed: Discovered the operating system, kernel, service manager, security state, listeners, worker behavior, installed component versions, failures, and protected-file checksums.
Created the locked non-login system account `inventorysvc` with its own UID/GID and no supplementary groups.
Created and validated a root-owned, SELinux-labeled `inventory-worker.service` unit with automatic startup and service hardening.
Enabled and started the service, then verified its live process runs as UID/GID 992 in the correct systemd cgroup.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed and the service recovered automatically.
Completed a final security, ownership, process, listener, failure, cleanup, platform, and protected-file audit.

evidence.requirement: Run the worker as the managed `inventory-worker` service
evidence.summary: The validated unit invokes the required worker, is enabled and active, and recovered automatically after reboot.
The account is dedicated, locked, non-login, and has no supplementary groups. Live `/proc`, process, and cgroup evidence shows the service runs with UID/GID 992 and NoNewPrivileges enabled.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release, kernel, worker, and security/access controls
evidence.summary: Before-and-after evidence shows RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 unchanged, the worker checksum unchanged, SELinux enforcing, SSH active, and the SSH configuration checksum preserved.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery proof
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID was 7ef78016-ba83-4481-867b-e5a349df1b54; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the recovered boot ID was 0a23f1e5-1ce7-4930-a3d9-868a6b7e9568; post-restart evidence proves system health, SSH access, unchanged data checksums, and automatic service recovery under `inventorysvc`.
